skillFull: Sprays Onion Juice at certain intervals, creating Tear Jellies. Sprayed obstacles become intangible, allowing the Cookie to pass through them. A certain amount of Tear Jellies become Life Tear Jellies restoring some Energy. Level Up for more points for Tear Jellies and to create more Life Tear Jellies.
story: A fish that Onion Cookie found swimming in her tears one day. It enjoys swimming in tears. And when it feels dehydrated, it's start spraying Onion Juice to extract tears from anything that surrounds it!
